blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Commercial video-generation APIs bill by model and tier, while intermediaries could substitute cheaper models, lower tiers, or cached clips. What can a delivered file establish about its origin? We combine measurements of passive attribution and cryptographic provenance into a graded audit. We test attribution probes and zero-shot detectors under re-encoding, downscaling, and frame-rate changes, and survey C2PA and GB 45438 metadata across 19 commercial endpoints. Only authenticated provenance supports accusations: tier contradictions or duplicate signed instances under fresh-generation contracts, excluding retries and idempotent returns. Unverifiable signed-endpoint deliveries trigger original-file demands under pass-through clauses; archive-reuse and delivery-parameter screens support review only. Six-model container and bitstream accuracy falls from 83.9% on raw files to 45.3% after uniform re-encoding, using different feature sets. Subsampling real references from 24 to 3 fps raises pooled D3 AUROC from 0.845 to 0.988. Only BytePlus authenticates tier claims under our pinned policy, including 187/187 audited deliveries across three Seedance tiers; tested remuxing and re-encoding leave processed Seedance files unverifiable. The audit identifies authenticated contradictions in 100/100 raw 720p signed tier-swap cases, with zero observed false flags on the tested honest pools.
blocks.zh: 商业录像制作 API按模型和层次计账单,而中介可以替代更便宜的模型,低层次,或缓存的片段. 送来的文件能确定它的来源吗? 我们把对被动归属和密码来源的测量合并为分级审计。 我们在重新编码、缩小尺度和帧率变化下测试归属探测器和零射线探测器,并在19个商业终点上调查C2PA和GB 45438元数据。 只有经证实的出处才能证明指控:在新一代合同下存在层次矛盾或重复签署的情况,不包括重复和独断专行的回报。 无法核实的签名端点交付触发了通过条款下的原始文件要求;档案-再使用和交付参数屏幕只支持审查. 六型容器和比特流精度从原始文件中的83.9%降至45.3%,统一重编码后使用不同的功能集. 将真实参考的样本从24至3英尺提高集合D3 AUROC从0.845提高到0.988。 只有BytePlus认证了我们所担保的分级索赔,包括3个种子等级的187/187个经审计的交付额;经过测试的重新刷新和重新编码休假处理的种子文件无法核实。 审计查明了100/100原始720p签名的分级洗牌案件中经认证的矛盾之处,在测试的诚实池上没有观察到假旗.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Commercial video-generation APIs bill a buyer (auditor) per delivery (returned video file) according to the requested endpoint (named model and tier), spanning $0.13–$1.17 per clip across 19 endpoints in our pilot ledger. In selected within-vendor comparisons across four vendors (model developers), cheaper tiers cost 25–79% less than premium tiers. When requests pass through an intermediary provider (gateway, platform, or reseller), that price spread creates a potential incentive to substitute another model or tier, downgrade rendering compute, mix substitutes into a fraction of jobs, or serve cached clips (threats S1–S5, defined in Sec. 3 ). Yet the buyer observes only the delivered file, timing and billing records, and inspected final gateway job objects exposing no upstream model or tier identity. Nor can a buyer build reference clips by seeded replay: byte-identical seeded requests roughly 3 h apart failed a pre-registered 0.90 SSIM gate on all 6/6 tested endpoints (3 pairs per endpoint; maximum 0.876). These constraints pose a core forensic question: what can a delivered clip establish about the model and tier that produced it?
blocks.zh: 商业录像制作 APIs向买方(审计人)开具发票,每交付一次(退回的视频文件),按照要求的终点(名牌型号和等级),从我们试点分类账的19个终点每段0.13美元到1.17美元不等。 在选定的四个供应商(模型开发商)的供应商内部比较中,比溢价低25-79%。 当请求通过一个中介供应商(门路、平台或转售商)时,这种价格波动可能会产生一种诱因,以替代另一种模式或层次,降低等级的计算,将替代品混入一小部分工作,或服务缓存的短片(威胁S1-S5, Sec. 3定义)。 然而,买方只观察了交付的文件、时间和账单记录,并检查了没有显示上游模式或级别身份的最终网关工作对象。 买方也不能通过播种重播建立参考夹:字节相同的播种请求相隔约3小时,在所有6/6试验终点上预先注册的0.90 SSIM门失败(每个终点3对;最高0.876)。 这些制约因素提出了一个核心的法证问题:发送的剪辑能够确定产生这种剪辑的模式和层次吗?

blocks.en: Figure 1: The attribution–authentication gap in commercial video-generation APIs. (a) Visual attribution bound: provider-controlled delivery formatting and reference frame-rate choices shift raw attribution and zero-shot detection (six-way container/bitstream accuracy is 83.9% raw and 45.3% after uniform re-encoding, using different feature sets), while pixel probes after uniform re-encoding separate most versions and vendors yet stay below accusation grade, and unauthenticated gateway labels do not distinguish tier differences from a shared generator or substitution. (b) Provenance authentication bound: signature validity, pinned signer trust, signed claim granularity, and unverified internal computation form four distinct levels; 18/19 surveyed models attach metadata, but only one vendor authenticates tiers under our pinned policy, tested processing leaves C2PA deliveries unverifiable, and the tested store lacks request binding. (c) Buyer recourse: because statistical triggers face high honest-clip certification costs and unauthenticated gateway references, recourse divides into Prove , Demand , and Flag or abstain via review-grade ARM and DPM screens.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 商业视频生成API的归属-认证差距. (a) 视觉归属约束:供应商控制的交付格式化和参考帧率选择转移原始归属和零镜头检测(六路集装箱/比特流精度为83.9%,统一重编码后为45.3%),使用不同的功能集;而像素探测器在统一重编码后,对大多数版本进行单独编码,供应商仍低于指控级别,未经认证的网关标签不区分等级差异与共享生成器或替换。 (b) 认证约束:签名有效性、封存标志信任、签名索赔颗粒度和未经核实的内部计算构成四个不同的层次;18/19调查模型附附元数据,但根据我们的封存政策,只有一个供应商认证级,经过测试的处理使C2PA交付无法核实,而且被测试的商店缺乏要求约束。 (c) 买方追索权:由于统计触发器面临高额的诚实-clip认证费用和未经认证的网关引用,追索权通过审查级ARM和DPM屏幕分为Prove、Demand和Flag或弃权。

blocks.en:
Evidence from the file alone is bounded from two sides, leaving a gap between passive visual forensics and cryptographic provenance (Fig. 1 ).
On the visual side, subsampling 24-fps real reference clips to 3 fps inside nominal 24-fps H.264 encodes lifts pooled AUROC of the zero-shot generated-video detector D3 [ 42 ] from 0.845 to 0.988 while shifting STALL [ 14 ] in the opposite direction, reversing their descriptive, computed-after-the-run ordering in this shared real cohort. Six-model container and bitstream accuracy is 83.9% on raw deliveries and 45.3% after uniform H.264 re-encoding, using different feature sets across steps. After uniform re-encoding, within-condition pixel probes separate most model versions and vendors across 45 pairs, yet same-version tier AUROC ranges from near chance on Wan 3.0 Prime vs. 3.0 (0.508–0.551) to 0.863 on C2PA-authenticated Seedance 2.0 Mini vs. 2.0 Fast. No passive probe reaches accusation grade, and for endpoints without tier-authenticating provenance under our pinned policy, gateway labels do not independently establish the true generating tier.
blocks.zh:
仅从档案中得出的证据就来自两面,在被动的视觉法证和密码来源之间留下了空白(图1)。
在视觉方面,对标称的24-fps H.264 编码内3英尺的24-fps真实参考片段进行子抽样,将零发生成的视频探测器D3[42]的集合AUROC从0.845移到0.988,同时将STALL[14]向相反方向移动,逆转其描述性,计算后运行命令在这个共享的真实组群中. 6型容器和比特流精度在生货时为83.9%,在统一H.264重新编码后为45.3%,使用跨步骤的不同特性集. 在统一重新编码后,条件内像素探测器将大多数模型版本和售货商分开,跨越45对,然而同版本的AUROC级别则从Wan 3.0 Prime vs 3.0(0.508–0.551)的接近机会到C2PA认证的种子2.0 Mini vs的0.863. 2.0快报. 任何被动的探针都达不到指控的级别,对于没有根据我们固定政策进行分级认证的终点,网关标签不能独立确定真正的生成级别。

blocks.en: On the provenance side, a valid C2PA signature [ 6 ] authenticates only a trusted signer’s claim about the original file at the signed granularity, never internal weights or compute. Across 19 surveyed models (605 deliveries, including 9 single-clip models at n = 1 n=1 ), 18 attach metadata, yet C2PA under our pinned signer policy authenticates tier claims for only BytePlus across three multi-clip Seedance 2.x tiers (187/187 verified, plus Seedance 2.0 at n = 1 n=1 ). Other surveyed endpoints verify only at model granularity (FLUX.3, n = 1 n=1 ), fail credential validation despite a C2PA-listed root (Runway Gen-4.5, n = 1 n=1 ), use per-clip self-signed certificate authorities (CAs) across tiers (Grok), or attach vendor-level GB 45438-2025 [ 27 ] strings whose vendor integrity schemes and external verification keys were not supplied (buyer verification untested). The tested remuxing and re-encoding operations leave previously verifiable C2PA deliveries unverifiable, often by removing their manifests (cross-vendor survival matrix preliminary, with n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 clips per vendor and transform), and the tested Seedance manifest store omits request binding and trusted signing timestamps.
blocks.zh: 在原产地方面,有效的C2PA签名[6]只认证了一个受信任的签名人对在所签名颗粒处的原始文件的索赔,而从来不是内部权重或计算。 在19个被调查的模型中(605次交付,包括9个单剪切模型,以n=1n=1),18个附加元数据,然而,根据我们的固定标志政策,只有BytePlus在3个多剪切2.x级(187/187经核实,加上N=1n=1的种子2.0)。 其他被调查的端点仅在型号颗粒性(FLUX.3,n = 1 n = 1)中进行验证,尽管有一个C2PA上市根(Runway Gen-4.5,n = 1 n = 1 n = 1),使用跨层(Grok)的clip自签证书当局(CA),或附加供应商级的GB 45438-2025[27]字符串,其供应商完整性计划和外部验证密钥没有提供(买方验证未测试),但验证失败. 已测试的重排和重编码操作使先前可核查的C2PA交付无法核实,通常通过去除其货单(跨供应商生存矩阵初步,每个供应商有n 3 n\leq 3夹并转换),已测试的种子清单商店省略了请求装订和信任的签名时间戳.

blocks.en:
We study model-substitution forensics on video-generation APIs by jointly evaluating passive attribution, deployed provenance, and the recourse available to a buyer.
In a 30-delivery audit at 10% substitution mixing, certifying a 1-of-30 statistical trigger requires 8,943 zero-failure honest clips per endpoint, while wholesale multi-clip tests still face unauthenticated gateway references, unseen substitutes, and unestablished stationarity across sessions. Buyer recourse therefore splits into proving unmodified signed tier contradictions or duplicate signed instance IDs ( k = 1 k=1 ), demanding vendor originals under a pass-through clause when signed-endpoint deliveries arrive unverifiable, and flagging or abstaining elsewhere via two review-grade screens: archive reuse matching (ARM) [ 37 , 32 ] and delivery-parameter matching (DPM).
blocks.zh:
我们通过联合评估被动归属、部署的出处和买家可利用的渠道,研究视频生成API上的模型替代法证。
在以10%的替代混合方式进行的30次交付审计中,验证一个1~30个统计触发器需要每个端点8,943个零故障的诚实剪辑,而批发的多剪辑测试仍然面临未经认证的网关引用,没有隐形的替代品,而且各届间没有固定的站点。 因此,买方的追索权分为证明未经修改的签名层级矛盾或重复签名实例ID(k = 1 k = 1),在签名端点交货到达无法核实时要求供应商的通过条款原件,并通过两个审查级屏幕在其他地方标出或弃权:归档再利用匹配(ARM)[37,32]和交付参数匹配(DPM)。

blocks.en: • Visual forensics bounds: Across two 8-fps zero-shot detectors (D3, STALL), one 24-fps real cohort, and 10 commercial models (45 pairs), controlled changes in effective temporal sampling shift zero-shot detection and can reverse descriptive, post-run detector ordering within the tested real cohort. We also show how attribution depends on processing and available feature sets, grading re-encoded pairwise separability from strong cross-version and cross-vendor separation down to near-chance same-version tiers. • Deployed provenance census: Across a 19-model, 605-delivery corpus spanning C2PA and GB 45438-2025, we evaluate deployed credentials using a pinned-policy verifier and 18 adversarial controls. We characterise metadata presence, signer trust, claim granularity, processing fragility, and the absence of request binding in the tested manifest store. • Provenance-first graded audit: Grounded in calibration-cost and reference-authenticity bounds that keep passive classifiers out of standalone accusation triggers, we formulate graded Prove , Demand , and Flag or abstain rules. We evaluate these rules across 2,061 constructed fresh-substitution cases, 160 one-pass normalised substitutes, and 390 archive-reuse deliveries.
blocks.zh: • 支助 视觉法证界限: 通过两个8英尺零射线探测器(D3,STALL),一个24英尺真组,以及10个商业型号(45对),在有效的时间采样转移零射线探测中发生可控变化,并可在被测试的真实组内逆转描述性,运行后的探测器订购. 我们还显示归属如何依赖于处理和可用的功能集,将重编码的对映可分性从强跨版和跨vendor分离向下分级到接近chance的同版级. • 部署地点普查: 我们通过一个19型605型的交付书 跨越C2PA和GB 45438 -2025, 通过一个固定政策核查器和18个对抗控制来评估部署的证书。 我们描述元数据的存在,签名者信任,声称颗粒性,处理脆弱,以及在测试的明细表存储中缺乏请求约束. • 一级验证审计: 我们以校准成本和参考真实性为基准, 将被动分类者排除在独立指控触发器之外, 我们评价这些规则涉及2 061个已建成的新替代案例、160个单程正常替代物和390个档案再使用交付。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Detection benchmarks [ 4 , 23 ] evaluate binary real-versus-synthetic classifiers [ 28 ] , including training-free detectors built on second-order temporal feature differences in D3 [ 42 ] and spatial-temporal likelihoods in STALL [ 14 ] .
Binary detection identifies neither the generating model nor the paid tier.
Moreover, frame-rate subsampling of identical real reference clips causally inflates D3 while shifting STALL in the opposite direction, even inside nominal 24-fps encodes.
blocks.zh:
检测基准[4,23]评价二进制真和合成分类器[28],包括基于D3[42]和STALL[14]中二顺序时间特征差异的无训练探测器。
二进制检测既不识别生成模型,也不识别付费层次.
此外,同样真实的参考片段的帧速率亚采样因果性地膨胀了D3,同时将STALL向相反方向移动,甚至在名义上的24-fps编码内.

blocks.en:
Source-attribution methods learn generator fingerprints [ 20 , 36 , 19 ] or probe visual backbones [ 38 , 26 , 22 ] across open and commercial generators [ 29 , 11 ] .
Classical media forensics instead targets spatial resampling [ 24 , 17 ] , frame-rate conversion [ 2 , 35 ] , double compression [ 30 ] , and near-duplicate copy retrieval [ 18 , 37 , 32 ] .
Unlike closed benchmarks, commercial intermediaries control container packaging and re-encoding, may apply super-resolution [ 31 ] or frame interpolation [ 16 , 25 ] , and expose unauthenticated gateway labels on endpoints without tier-authenticating provenance; across 45 commercial pairs, re-encoded separability remains pair-specific and below accusation grade on tiers.
blocks.zh:
来源分配方法学习发电机指纹[20,36,19]或探测器视觉主干线[38,26,22],跨越开放型和商用发电机[29,11].
古典媒体鉴证则针对空间重印[24,17],帧率转换[2,35],双压缩[30],近复制副本检索[18,37,32].
与封闭基准不同的是,商业中介控制集装箱包装和重编码,可能采用超分辨率[31]或帧插值[16,25],并在端点上暴露未经认证的网关标签,而不进行分级认证的出处;在45对商业对中,重编码的可分离性仍然是对等的,在分级上低于指控等级.

blocks.en:
C2PA [ 6 ] binds signed claims to asset hashes, though recent analyses document trust-list and specification gaps [ 12 ] and manifest–watermark desynchronisation [ 21 ] .
Invisible watermarks [ 8 , 33 , 9 , 15 ] face removal and regeneration attacks [ 41 , 1 ] , while China’s GB 45438-2025 [ 27 , 7 ] standardises producer and propagator metadata.
Rather than proposing a new watermark, we measure what already deployed C2PA and GB 45438 metadata establish for an API buyer across signer trust, claim granularity, processing survival, and request binding.
blocks.zh:
C2PA[6]将签定的索赔与资产散列捆绑在一起,尽管最近的分析记录了信托清单和规格空白[12]和表-水标记同步[21]。
隐形水印[8,33,9,15]面临移除和再生攻击[41,1],而中国GB 45438-2025[27,7]规范化生产商和宣传商元数据.
我们不是提出一个新的水印,而是衡量已经部署的C2PA和GB 45438元数据为一个API购买者建立了哪些跨签署者信托,主张颗粒性,处理生存性,以及要求装订。

blocks.en:
Recent LLM API audits test model equality [ 10 ] , cheaper-model substitution [ 3 ] , shadow routing [ 39 , 40 , 34 ] , and multi-hop attestation [ 13 ] .
Unlike cheap text queries or cooperative server attestation, commercial video clips cost $0.13–$1.17 each and certifying a 1-of-30 statistical trigger at 10% mixing requires 8,943 zero-failure honest clips per endpoint. Combined with unauthenticated gateway references on endpoints lacking tier-level signatures, these costs motivate graded recourse anchored on deployed vendor signatures.
blocks.zh:
最近的 LLM API审计测试模型平等[10],更便宜的模型替代[3],阴影路由[39,40,34],以及多跳证明[13].
与廉价文本查询或合作服务器验证不同,商业视频剪辑成本为每集0.13美元-1.17美元,以10%的混合方式认证1~30个统计触发器需要每个端点8,943个零故障的诚实剪辑. 这些费用加上没有各级签名的端点的未经认证的网关引用,促使人们根据已部署的供应商签名分级追索。

blocks.en: 3 API Delivery Setting and Commercial Corpus
blocks.zh: API 交货设置和商业公司

blocks.en:
A buyer (auditor) orders clips from a named model and tier ( endpoint ) served by an intermediary provider (platform, gateway, or reseller), while the vendor trains the generator and, where deployed, signs provenance.
Each returned file is a delivery , and an audit inspects n = 30 n=30 deliveries from one endpoint. The buyer sets the prompt, seed, target resolution, aspect ratio, duration, image-to-video (I2V) first frame, audio flag, and submission timing; explicit pixel dimensions, last-frame conditioning, and multi-account probing are untested.
For each request, the buyer observes only the raw delivered bytes, gateway response fields, submission and completion timestamps, and billed cost. Inspected final gateway job objects carry only id , generation_id , status , usage.cost , usage.is_byok , and expires_at , exposing no upstream vendor or tier identity.
blocks.zh:
买方(审计人)从一个命名的模型和一级(终点)订购夹片,由中间供应商(平台、网关或转售商)提供服务,而供应商则对发电机进行培训,并在部署时标明出处。
每个退回的文件都是送货,审计检查n=30n=30从一个端点送货. 买方设定了即时,种子,目标分辨率,宽度比,持续时间,图像对视频(I2V)第一帧,音频旗,以及提交时间;清晰的像素尺寸,末帧条件,以及多账号的检测均未测试.

blocks.en:
A provider controlling the delivery pipeline may apply five substitution classes: serving a cross-vendor model (S1), serving a cheaper within-vendor tier (S2), rendering the claimed model at lower compute (S3) via spatial upscaling (S3-sp), temporal interpolation (S3-t), or fewer denoising steps (S3-st), partial mixing at rate p p (S4), or returning cached earlier clips (S5).
Providers may also re-encode video, strip or transplant metadata, apply learned super-resolution [ 31 ] or interpolation [ 16 , 25 ] , or route requests selectively.
On endpoints with tier-authenticating provenance, post-generation S3 re-rendering leaves C2PA deliveries unverifiable and triggers an original-file demand, whereas passive visual detection of unsigned S3 downgrades was not evaluated. Pre-signing compute degradation by the vendor itself, signing-key compromise, and legal enforcement are outside scope because cryptographic signatures authenticate vendor claims rather than internal execution.

blocks.en: We first evaluate two training-free zero-shot generated-video detectors that sample video at 8 fps—the D3 detector [ 42 ] , which scores second-order temporal feature differences, and STALL [ 14 ] , which combines spatial and temporal likelihoods—alongside supervised attribution probes across 1,000 24-fps real clips and all 520 Main deliveries (10 models, 45 pairs; Fig. 2 ). Two bounded findings emerge: effective temporal sampling rather than H.264 compression drives zero-shot detection shifts even inside nominal 24-fps files, and pairwise attribution depends on processing condition and is graded pair by pair.

We introduced a 24-fps real reference of 1,000 GenVideo real clips [ 4 ] after identifying that frame-rate confound in the original MSR-VTT comparison, yielding comparable per-model AUROCs for D3 (0.813–0.872) and STALL (0.818–0.880); the subsequent within-GenVideo intervention tests temporal sampling on those exact same real clips. blocks.en: Changing H.264 compression alone (CRF 18 or 28 at 24 fps) alters pooled AUROC by less than 0.002 for both detectors (Tab. 2 ). By contrast, 3-fps real subsampling lifts pooled D3 AUROC from 0.845 to 0.988 ( + 0.143 +0.143 ) and lowers STALL from 0.852 to 0.801 ( − 0.051 -0.051 ), causing STALL to fail its pre-registered invariance criterion of an absolute AUROC change below 0.05. D3 rises at 12 fps (0.900), returns to baseline at 8 fps (0.846), and approaches ceiling separation at 6 fps (0.977) and 3 fps (0.988), whereas the symmetric control—which subsamples the generated clips to 3 fps as well—pushes D3 below baseline to 0.785 and satisfies both pre-registered criteria: the real-only 3-fps intervention raises AUROC by at least 0.05 with a confidence interval above zero ( + 0.143 +0.143 , [ 0.126 , 0.161 ] [0.126,0.161] ), and applying the intervention to generated clips as well reduces the excess to less than half the real-only excess ( − 0.060 -0.060 vs. + 0.143 +0.143 ). STALL stays flat at 12 and 8 fps, declines at 6 and 3 fps, and rises to 0.914 under the symmetric 3-fps control. Descriptively, computed after the run, detector ordering flips across sampling rates in this shared real cohort: D3 leads STALL on 3/10 models at 24 and 8 fps, on 10/10 models at 12, 6, and 3 fps, and on 0/10 models under the symmetric 3-fps control.

blocks.en: Both detectors sample decoded frames at an 8-fps stride, which interacts with frame duplication inside nominal 24-fps streams in three regimes: • at 12 fps duplicated to 24 fps, an 8-fps stride lands on alternating one- and two-frame source steps; • at 8 fps encoded at 24 fps, an 8-fps stride sees equal single-step intervals matching native 24-fps sampling; • at 6 and 3 fps encoded at 24 fps, consecutive 8-fps samples repeatedly hit identical duplicated frames. In a descriptive component readout, computed after the run on cached frozen features, D3’s detection AUROC tracks the spread (standard deviation) of its second-order feature differences within 0.004 AUROC across all six comparisons. On the real cohort, that second-order spread rises at 12 fps (median 4.068 vs. 3.440 at 24 fps) while mean first-order step size barely moves (8.582 vs. 8.781), returns to baseline at 8 fps (3.447), and grows sharply at 6 and 3 fps (7.066 and 9.124) as repeated frames shrink first-order differences (7.403 and 4.751). STALL’s shift concentrates in its temporal likelihood term, whose single-statistic AUROC drops from 0.791 at 24 fps to 0.715 at 3 fps and rises to 0.923 under the symmetric control while its spatial term stays within 0.846–0.858; this identifies the moving components, whereas causal mediation via frame deduplication before scoring remains untested.

blocks.en: 4.3 Processing-Dependent, Pair-Specific Visual Separability

blocks.en: To measure visual separability after packaging normalisation across all 45 Main pairs (40 or 60 shared prompts per pair), we evaluate three pixel-level feature families retrained within each processing condition, claiming no cross-condition transfer. The semantic probe mean-pools SigLIP [ 38 ] frame embeddings (capturing rendered appearance rather than generator-invariant content alone), while the video probe extracts X-CLIP [ 22 ] video embeddings at N2 and the 480p CRF-32 round trip only. Over 16 evenly spaced frames, the 110-dimensional low-level probe combines a 64-bin radial log power spectrum and 20 block-DCT statistics (mean and variance of 10 low-order AC magnitudes) of the 3 × 3 3\times 3 luma median-filter residual with 4 first- and second-order temporal luma-difference statistics and 22 colour statistics (RGB mean/std plus a 16-bin saturation histogram), so it is not purely a noise residual. All three feature families use logistic regression (LR), with features standardised inside each training fold; the regularisation parameter is selected from { 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \{0.01,0.1,1,10\} by an inner three-fold prompt-grouped log-loss search, evaluation uses outer five-fold prompt-grouped cross-validation, and pairwise confidence intervals use 2,000 prompt-cluster bootstrap resamples.

blocks.en: 5 What Deployed Provenance Establishes
blocks.zh: 5 所部署的证据

blocks.en: 5.1 Four Authentication Levels and Pinned-Policy Verification
blocks.zh: 5.1 四个认证级别和固定政策核查

blocks.en: Evaluating cryptographic provenance [ 6 , 12 ] requires keeping four levels distinct: • Level 1 (Cryptographic validity): checks manifest parsing, claim-signature validity ( claimSignature.validated ), and bmffHash payload binding; it establishes byte integrity since signing, but cannot rule out self-signed per-clip CAs or untrusted third-party signers. • Level 2 (Signer trust): checks that the certificate chain anchors to a pinned root fingerprint and matches a pinned leaf subject ( organization and organizationIdentifier , rather than rotating certificate serials), with certificate validity and revocation verified; it establishes organisational signer identity under the buyer’s policy, not model or tier identity. • Level 3 (Claim consistency): compares the signed identity assertion (such as model_name ) against the ordered endpoint at the signed granularity and checks the active manifest’s instance ID against prior authenticated billed deliveries; it establishes whether the vendor’s claim matches the order, contradicts it, or duplicates an earlier job. • Level 4 (Internal computation): covers model weights, denoising steps, internal resolution, and quantisation; no file-carried signature can establish internal execution.
blocks.zh: 评价密码来源[6,12]需要保持四个等级的区别: 第一级(计算机有效性):核对表解析、权利要求签字有效性(claimature.validated )和bmffHash有效载荷装订;它确立了自签署以来的字节完整性,但不能排除自签的每克CA或不信任的第三方签名人。 · 第2级(签字人信任):检查证书链系到钉住的根指纹,并与钉住的叶片(组织和组织识别器,而不是旋转证书序列)相匹配,并核实证书的有效性和吊销情况;根据买方的政策确定组织签字人的身份,而不是模型或层次的身份。 · 第三级(要求一致性):将签名的身份断言(例如型号_名称)与所签名颗粒物的定点进行对比,对照先前经认证的发票交付,核对现行货单的标识;确定供应商的主张是否与订单相符、是否与订单相矛盾或是否重复了早先的工作。 • 第4级(内部计算):包括模型权重、解密步骤、内部分辨率和量化;任何带文件的签名都不能确定内部执行。

blocks.en: Level 3 (Claim consistency): compares the signed identity assertion (such as model_name ) against the ordered endpoint at the signed granularity and checks the active manifest’s instance ID against prior authenticated billed deliveries; it establishes whether the vendor’s claim matches the order, contradicts it, or duplicates an earlier job.

blocks.en: Let F F denote our strict C2PA verifier, which enforces Levels 1–3 sequentially (full specification in Appendix A.2 ). Given raw delivered bytes, F F validates the claim signature and bmffHash asset binding, rejects any chain not anchored to the pinned root and leaf subject, checks audit-time validity and leaf revocation, compares the signed tier claim against the order, and checks the manifest instance ID against the ledger of authenticated billed jobs, returning verified , contradictory , duplicate , or unverifiable .
blocks.zh: F 表示严格的C2PA核查员,该核查员依次执行第1至第3级(附录A.2中的全部说明)。 鉴于原始交付字节,F F 验证索赔签名和bmffHash资产绑定,拒绝任何没有固定在被绑根和叶子上的链条,检查审计时间有效性和叶片吊销,将签名的分级索赔与订单进行比较,并对照经认证的计费工作分类账检查清单实例ID,返回经核实、相互矛盾、重复或无法核实。

blocks.en: These checks answer separate forensic questions. Across all 187 audited BytePlus deliveries in Main and Low-res spanning Seedance 2.5, 2.0 Fast, and 2.0 Mini, 187/187 returned verified with signed model_name matching the ordered tier (plus four verified Census clips, including Seedance 2.0 at n = 1 n=1 ; 191 files total). All BytePlus files chain across three certificates from Byteplus Pte. Ltd. to GlobalSign Secure Mail Root R45 , which is in the Mozilla root store (e-mail trust bit) but not on the C2PA trust list—making signer trust an explicit buyer policy choice rather than an ecosystem guarantee. Separately from signer identity and tier naming, the tested Seedance manifest store records only a signer-asserted action time ( when ) and omits a trusted RFC 3161 signing timestamp, so certificate validity and signature-verified leaf OCSP ( GOOD ) are checked at audit time rather than proving signing time. Across the population, F F logged 0/187 duplicate instance IDs (all 6/6 seeded replays carried fresh IDs) and placed all 18/18 adversarial controls—mdat byte flips, cross-tier manifest transplants, three forged signer chains, raw cheaper-tier swaps, CRF-23 re-encodes, and re-presented originals—into the expected rejection class and failure reason (Appendix A.2 ).

blocks.en: Second, GB 45438-2025 [ 27 , 7 ] metadata is vendor-level and informational for a buyer. blocks.en: Third, deployed C2PA credentials are fragile under routine media processing. In our preliminary cross-vendor survival matrix ( n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 clips per vendor and transform; Appendix A.2 ), remuxing, metadata stripping, and CRF-23 or CRF-28 re-encoding left 0/3 Seedance and 0/1 FLUX.3 deliveries verifiable by removing their C2PA manifests altogether, even when FFmpeg metadata-copy flags were passed. Across the three GB 45438 vendors, labels likewise vanished by default under remuxing and re-encoding (0/3 per vendor) and survived only explicit metadata-tag copying (3/3 per vendor).
blocks.zh: 第三,部署的C2PA证书在例行媒体处理下是脆弱的。 在我们的初步跨供应商生存矩阵中(每个供应商3 n\leq 3 片段和变换;附录A.2),重置、元数据剥离和CRF-23或CRF-28重编码,留下0/3种子和0/1 FLUX.3的交付可核查,完全去除其C2PA的表单,即使在FFmpeg元数据复制标记通过时也是如此。 在三个GB 45438的供应商中,标签同样默认在重修和重新编码下消失(每个供应商0/3),仅幸存了明显的元数据数据库复制(每个供应商3/3)。

blocks.en: Fourth, deployed provenance omits request binding and can shift across sessions. The tested Seedance manifest store carries no prompt, request parameters, or client nonce, so provenance alone cannot detect cross-buyer replay of a genuine signed clip. In our preliminary second session eight days later ( n = 2 n=2 sessions, one clip per model across six Census endpoints), 5/6 re-tested models kept the same regime and identity fields, whereas Kling 3.0 Pro added a vendor-level self-signed C2PA manifest (“Kling AI”) alongside GB 45438.

blocks.en: ARM screens cached reuse (S5) against the buyer’s own archive, so its reference authenticity rests on prior possession rather than generator labels. ARM uses a 63 + 64 ​ m 63+64m -bit perceptual hash [ 37 ] , where m ≤ 17 m\leq 17 is the number of sampled frames, and coarse SSIM [ 32 ] computed at 8 fps after resizing to 64 pixels in width; a match requires normalised Hamming distance at most 0.05 and SSIM at least 0.90, and unequal-length hashes cannot match (Appendix A.1 ). Pairs with unequal hash lengths are marked non-comparable in negative diagnostics, retained in total pair counts, and counted as misses on planted copies. Across the 586 clips in Main and Low-res (171,405 total pairs), ARM produced 0 false matches among 133,359 comparable cross-prompt pairs (168,081 total), 48 same-model regenerations (48 comparable), and 2,245 comparable other same-prompt pairs (3,276 total). On the 390 archive-reuse cases in Substitution (10 signed Seedance and 20 unsigned Wan 3.0, Grok 1.5, HappyHorse 1.1, and Kling 3.0 Std sources across 13 transforms), F F flags 0/260 unsigned reuses whereas ARM flags 130/260 for review: 116/120 across unedited, CRF-23/28, 480p, and colour-shifted copies (79/80 plus 37/40), 12/20 at 5% speed-up, and 1/20 each on 5% crop and 10% speed-up, while missing 80/80 under 10% crop, trims, and horizontal flip (0/80 flagged; learned matchers such as ViSiL [ 18 ] were not evaluated). ARM stays strictly at review grade ( RV \mathrm{RV} ): on the 130 signed-endpoint reuses, F F proves 10/10 raw duplicates ( AD \mathrm{AD} ) and demands originals on 120/120 processed copies, where ARM adds 57/120 reuse identifications and 0 extra escalations.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
All deliveries in Main , Census , and Low-res traversed one gateway (OpenRouter) without direct vendor API contracts, mostly in a single session (plus a preliminary second session for six models at one clip each, n = 2 n=2 sessions). Our findings therefore characterise the tested endpoints rather than the wider industry.
Of 19 surveyed models, only BytePlus signed verifiable tiers across three multi-clip Seedance 2.x tiers (plus Seedance 2.0 at n = 1 n=1 ), and deployments can change across sessions, as Kling 3.0 Pro’s added self-signed C2PA ( n = 1 n=1 ) illustrates.

blocks.en: Endpoints without tier-authenticating provenance under our pinned policy yield no identity proof: passive attribution labels and DPM reference pools rely on unauthenticated gateway claims, DPM checks only unnormalised stream defaults, and ARM uses fixed-grid perceptual matching rather than learned copy detection. GB 45438-2025 labels [ 27 ] serve regulatory traceability rather than commercial tier authentication, with integrity fields whose vendor scheme and external verification key were not supplied (buyer verification untested) and a tier-blind ReservedCode1 prefix on Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime.

Provider cure of original-file demands, vendor-direct seed determinism, passive visual detection of unsigned S3 compute downgrades, and frame-deduplication mediation in zero-shot detectors remain untested, and we observed no live substitution and measured no prevalence.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Across the commercial endpoints we studied, what a delivered clip establishes about its model and tier is bounded from two sides.
Visually, effective temporal sampling rather than H.264 compression shifts zero-shot detectors and reverses their descriptive, post-run ordering in our shared real cohort even at nominal 24 fps. Pairwise separability across 45 pairs depends on processing and grades pair by pair down to near-chance tiers, while for endpoints without tier-authenticating provenance under our pinned policy, gateway labels do not independently establish the generating tier. Within our tested scope, two evaluation practices follow: zero-shot temporal detectors should be compared on real and generated cohorts matched in effective (unique-frame) sampling rate rather than nominal container rate alone, and commercial attribution should be reported after uniform re-encoding alongside raw-file results because attribution results depend on the processing condition and available feature set.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了商业终点, 所传送的片段确定了它的模型, 分层从两侧。
从视觉上看,有效的时间采样而不是H.264压缩转动零射线探测器,并在我们共享的真正组群中,甚至于名义上24英尺时,颠倒其描述性的,运行后的订单. 45对对的对等分离性取决于逐对的处理和分级,而对于端点,根据我们的固定政策,没有分级认证的出处,网关标签不能独立地建立生成层。 在我们试验范围内,有两种评价做法:对零发时间探测器应比较实际和生成的组群,以有效(独特的框架)取样率进行比对,而不是仅以名义集装箱率进行比对;在统一重新编码和原始文件结果之后,应报告商业归属,因为归属结果取决于处理条件和可用的特征。

blocks.en: Cryptographically, pinned-policy C2PA authenticates tier claims for only one surveyed vendor, leaves previously verifiable deliveries unverifiable under the tested remuxing and re-encoding operations (often by removing their manifests; cross-vendor survival matrix preliminary at n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 ), and omits request binding and trusted signing timestamps in the tested Seedance store. Buyer recourse therefore divides into Prove on unmodified signed contradictions or duplicates, Demand for vendor originals on unverifiable signed-endpoint deliveries, and Flag or abstain via review-grade ARM and DPM screens. Signing tier identifiers, client request nonces, and trusted timestamps under publicly anchored certificates would close the claim-granularity and replay gaps, whereas internal computation and signer trust remain beyond what a file alone can prove.
blocks.zh: 从密码学上讲,被绑定的C2PA只认证一个被调查的供应商的分级索赔,在经过测试的重整和重新编码操作(通常通过删除其清单;在n 3 n\leq 3 初步的交叉毒物生存矩阵)下,使以前可核查的交货无法核实,在经过测试的种子商店中省略了要求装订和信任的签名时间戳。 因此,买方的追索权分为:未经修改的签名矛盾或重复的证明;对无法核实的签名端交货的供应商原件的需求;通过审查级ARM和DPM屏幕的Flag或弃权。 签名层级标识符,客户端请求非ce,以及公设证书下可信任的时间戳,将关闭主张的宽度并重播漏洞,而内部计算和签名者信任度仍然超出仅一个文件所能证明的范围.

A.2 Pinned-Policy C2PA Verifier, Adversarial Controls, and Survival Matrix

blocks.en: Our strict verifier F F parses each file’s C2PA manifest store using the C2PA reference reader, requires a Valid or Trusted validation state and both claimSignature.validated and assertion.bmffHash.match , and rejects every SDK failure code except signingCredential.untrusted . That exception is accepted only when the independent pinned-path and audit-time checks pass; the earlier relaxed validation of 173 Seedance manifests ignored it without enforcing the pinned signer policy. To enforce Level 2 signer trust, F F pins both the root CA SHA-256 fingerprint and the leaf certificate subject ( organization and organizationIdentifier ) rather than certificate serial numbers, rejecting self-signed or unanchored chains. Certificate validity windows are checked at audit time alongside signature-verified OCSP leaf revocation ( GOOD , 0 revoked across BytePlus Seedance 2.x, whose single 3-certificate chain ends at GlobalSign Secure Mail Root R45 : Mozilla root store e-mail trust bit True , C2PA trust list False ).
